lessons.title: Numbers, age, and counters
lessons.objective: Numbers, age, and counters: Read numbers one to ten. なんにん means how many people; いくつ means how many general items. Use ～さい（歳） for age and an appropriate counter for objects; ～つ counts general items, while ～にん（人） counts people.
